patch_description: The current uniform-radius hex lattice caps every circle at the same radius (r≈0.0938, sum 2.44). Two improvements: (1) start from a staggered-row layout (rows 5,4,5,4,5,3) with wider spacing so some circles (edges of 4-circle rows, the 3-circle row) have room to grow beyond the uniform cap; (2) replace the uniform radius computation with a per-circle Gauss-Seidel "water-filling" radius growth (each circle grows up to its border distance minus neighbors' current radii), interleaved with a deterministic constraint-relaxation loop that nudges each center away from its active constraints (overlapping neighbors and walls). This mimics the structure of good non-uniform packings — smaller circles at corners/edges, larger circles in roomy spots — while remaining fully deterministic and guaranteeing a valid final configuration via a monotone (radii-only-shrinking) feasibility repair pass.
